mount_point.description: Root directory path to monitor for filesystem events

backend.description: Logging destination; either 'syslog' (system logging) or 'file' (dedicated log file)

log_file_path.description: Path to the log file (only used if backend is 'file')

json_output.description: Whether to emit each log entry as a structured JSON line (overrides prefix)

log_prefix.description: String prefix added before each log line (ignored if json_output is true)

max_log_size.description: Maximum size in bytes for a single log file before rotation

max_log_files.description: Maximum number of rotated log files to retain

log_operations.description: List of filesystem operations to log; if omitted or empty, all operations are logged

exclude_paths.description: List of path patterns (supports globs like * and ?) to exclude from logging

items.description: A glob pattern for paths to exclude

follow_symlinks.description: Whether to follow symbolic links when monitoring directory trees

log_metadata.description: Whether to log metadata changes (e.g., permissions, ownership, timestamps)
